context.content: Via the VZVZ website (www.vgvz.nl) you should be able access the LSP (Landelijk Schakel Punt) using DigiD. Strictly speaking this is not the complete overview of your EPD('s) because of legal reasons. For the EPD from specific health care institutions you should be able to get it from them completely. They may resist because they don't always understand that the subject is legally the owner of the data (as I also only learned when I was a member of a AVG / GDPR taak force).
